description: G2.5 anti-cliche veto rules. Unlike G2 grammar rules (which *mutate* bad values), these rules *refuse* a design outright. Toggle `enabled` to switch the gate on/off.

remediation.#FF0000: Replace pure red with dark cinnabar #8B2500 (zhusha-700); reserve red to ≤8% accent area.
remediation.#00FF00: Replace pure green with muted stone-green hsl(120,30%,30%) #2E7D32.
remediation.#FFD700: Replace bright gold with matte gold #B8860B; keep gold area ≤5%.
remediation.#000000: Replace pure black with ink-dark hsl(0,5%,12%) (#1F1F22).
remediation.#FFFFFF: Replace pure white with moon-white hsl(42,25%,92%) (#EDEAE4).
remediation.#00FFFF: Cyan/neon is forbidden — use a desaturated dai-blue #2C3E50.
